entities.name: Manolo Sanlúcar
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Manolo Sanlúcar was a Spanish flamenco composer and guitarist. He was considered one of the most important Spanish composers of recent times, and together with Paco de Lucía, Tomatito, and Vicente Amigo, one of the main figures in the evolution of the flamenco guitar.
